num_satellites: <int> Number of satellite transshipment facilities in the distribution network.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
num_groups: <int> Number of disjoint customer groups that must each be served from a single satellite.
Q1: <int> Carrying capacity of each first-echelon (large) vehicle.
Q2: <int> Carrying capacity of each second-echelon (small) vehicle.
T1: <int> Total number of first-echelon vehicles available at the depot.
T2: <int> Total number of second-echelon vehicles available across the entire system.

depot.id: <int> Unique node identifier for the depot.

satellites.id: <int> Unique node identifier for this satellite.
satellites.capacity: <int> Maximum total freight throughput this satellite can handle.
satellites.max_vehicles: <int> Maximum number of second-echelon vehicles that may operate from this satellite.
satellites.handling_cost: <float> Per-unit cost incurred for each unit of freight passing through this satellite.

customers.id: <int> Unique node identifier for this customer.
customers.demand: <int> Quantity of freight required by this customer.
customers.group: <int> Identifier of the customer group to which this customer belongs.

groups.group_id: <int> Unique identifier for this customer group.
groups.customer_ids: <list[int], length varies> Node identifiers of all customers belonging to this group.
